# Appendix: label triage {#sec-appendix-triage .unnumbered}

The machine-readable version of the label triage is `contract/label_triage.csv`, one row per legacy label of the current Excel tables; it is authoritative, and this appendix is its readable view. Every `MAP` row carries `status = DRAFT`: none of the 91 series it defines becomes `ACTIVE` until the user confirms or flips its hard case (@sec-hard-cases) at gate G1.

## The 82 `Departement` labels {#sec-appendix-triage-departement .unnumbered}

The `Departement` sheet exists only for Senegal. Per decision D3 all 82 of its labels are `SKIP`: 60 share a label with `ADM 1` but produce a different, mostly conflicting value under the same key, and 22 are unique to the sheet (raw collapse variables, a mislabelled PPP round, or poverty counts that disagree with the sheet's own rates). @tbl-triage-departement groups them; the full row-by-row detail, with each label's own reason in `notes`, is in `contract/label_triage.csv`.

| Group | Count | Example label(s) | Reason |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Raw `(max) con_k` collapse leftovers | 15 | `(max) con_1`, `(max) con_10` | Raw variable, not a defined indicator; values do not sum to 1 (1.48-3.02 per region) |
| Raw `(max) ext_emp` variable | 1 | `(max) ext_emp` | Raw variable, within 0.07 of `HE has external (non-HH) employees` (L038) |
| `Access to electricity (grid or off-grid)` | 1 | `Access to electricity (grid or off-grid)` | Distinct concept from `EN_ELEC_ACCESS` (grid only); not registered as a code |
| `Energy expenditure burden (share of total cons.)` | 1 | `Energy expenditure burden (share of total cons.)` | Dashboard shows an empty placeholder row for this label (index.qmd:127) |
| 2017-PPP poverty lines (mislabelled) | 2 | `Poor at \$3.00/day (2017 PPP)`, `Poor at \$4.20/day (2017 PPP)` | Mislabelled lines; the PPP_2017 exception for POVLINE_PL300 is removed per D3, and POVLINE_PL420 was never valid with PPP_2017 |
| Raw `npoor300` / `npoor420` variables | 2 | `npoor300`, `npoor420` | Disagree with the sheet's own rates (e.g. Diourbel 0.35M poor at rate 0.11 -> ~3.2M people) |
| 60 labels shared with `National`/`ADM 1`/`ZAE` | 60 | `Covariate economic shock`, `Covariate natural shock (drought, flood, etc.)` | Same key as the `ADM 1` row for the same label, but a different (mostly conflicting) value; superseded 2017-PPP poverty rows fold into this group too |

: The 82 `Departement` rows (all `SKIP`, D3), grouped by reason. {#tbl-triage-departement}
